notes.title: Assisted free cam improvements
notes.notes:
Video link:
[previewyoutube=_q2IE1VgruU;full][/previewyoutube]

Key Points:
- Movement anticipation, giving more visibility space on the player movement direction 
- Camera Heigh position Zoom dependant
- Camera stabilization while on air, to let you platforming more precisely
- Speed based auto rotation
- Camera smoothly aligns player direction
- Big jumps are easy to control now with Z adjusment based on vertical acceleration and player direction


Do you think this features should be optional?
I've been wondering if I should provide the player with a customization system to personalize this assisted camera or even disable it, do you think it would be useful?

I will be looking forward for your responses!

Thank you so much for your support so far!

notes.title: WIP FEATURES
notes.notes:
Hi! ːsteamhappyː
First of all, thank you so much for your support.
As I've been quiet for the last months, I wanted to share all the improvements I've been working during this time.
Here I share a list with all the updates, some of them still in WIP, that will be included in the next update:

WIP Features:
[list]
[*] CUSTOMIZATION
- New customization system with furry material
- New body pattern
- New color palette
- New eye iris shapes

[*] ANIMATIONS
- New Jump animations
- Character tilt animation on fast turns while running or falling
- New smooth animation transitions between actions

[*] CAM
- New recenter cam button
- Improved follow cam system, with auto orientation, movement prediction and Z adjustment

[*] SKILLS
- New ranged ability
- New long jump from ground
- New fast jump on landing
- New wall interation system, climb and wall jump
- New jump from ground rolling
- Air abilities redesign
- Improved button mapping, more intuitive and simple
- Improved ground rolling controls

[*] LEVEL DESIGN
- 1st World prototype (tutorial)
- 2nd World prototype

[*] CHARACTERS
- New Woody design
- New enemies
- New enemy ship
[/list]

Am I missing something? If you want any feature to be considered to be added to the task list or any improvement feel free to send feedback!
I will share a video with all the new update features once I have all of them well polished!

Thank you so much for your support
